philosophical_authority_bomb.structure: Provocative claim about human nature + attribute to respected philosopher
philosophical_authority_bomb.why_it_works: Quote protects you from attack. Controversy drives engagement. Sounds smart without trying.
mechanics: Use philosophers she's actually read (Nietzsche, Camus, Dostoevsky, Freud, Plato)
Pick quotes about gender, desire, power, or human nature
Never add your own commentary—let them fight in replies
High controversy but academically credible
philosophical_authority_bomb.example: "In revenge and in love, woman is more barbaric than man." — Nietzsche

intimate_command.structure: State what you want + exclude the obvious + explain why + direct command
intimate_command.why_it_works: Specificity feels genuine. Command positions you as curator. Creates obligation to respond.
mechanics: Use lowercase for intimacy
Be specific about what you DON'T want (shows taste)
Use fragments and ellipses for conversational rhythm
End with direct command ('show me', 'tell me')
Frame as curiosity, not neediness
intimate_command.example: i want to see something cool from your camera roll. not filtered faces. not recycled memes. i want your world. what you stop for. what you notice. just pictures you've actually taken… what you think is worth capturing. show me.

fake_vulnerability_check_in.structure: Simple caring question + command for honesty
fake_vulnerability_check_in.why_it_works: Appears warm while positioning you as therapist. Creates reply obligation. Everyone thinks it's personal.
mechanics: Keep under 10 words
Use lowercase
Add 'be honest' or 'really' to imply depth
Don't reply to everyone—scarcity maintains power
On brand for psychology student

innocent_curiosity_sexual.why_it_works: Plausible deniability. Academic framing. Gender dynamics guarantee engagement.
mechanics: Frame sexual topics as intellectual inquiry
Use 'just curious' or 'genuinely asking' for protection
Add period after disclaimer for detachment
Compare genders to invite both sides
Never apologize or explain intent
innocent_curiosity_sexual.example: does men's nakedness move women the way women's nakedness move men? just curious .

historical_authority_implication.structure: Ancient source(s) + unexpected connection + no commentary
historical_authority_implication.why_it_works: Multiple authorities = hard to dismiss. Unexpected pairing creates interest. Ambiguity allows projection.
mechanics: Use 2+ ancient sources when possible
Connect disparate concepts (love/war, pleasure/courage, desire/power)
Use formal phrasing ('have remarked', 'observed')
Never explain modern relevance—let them figure it out
Leave interpretation completely open
historical_authority_implication.example: Plutarch and Plato have already remarked that those nations most sensitive to the pleasures of love were also the most warlike and courageous.
